description.value: Taylor Inn is a full-service stopover in Taylor, BC, combining 10 hotel rooms (including 3 suites with full kitchens) with an on-site pub, restaurant, and liquor store that also stocks a small selection of groceries. The property has been under the same ownership since 2008 and caters to oilfield and contract workers as well as travellers needing stays from one night to several months. A touring cyclist arriving in this small northern BC community will find food, drink, and laundry all under one roof.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides clear evidence for several amenities: laundry service is explicitly stated on both the /hotel and /contact-us pages; on-site pub/restaurant and an on-site liquor store with a small grocery selection confirm food and grocery availability. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, charging) are mentioned anywhere. The OSM phone number (+1-250-789-3033) differs from the website's listed main line (250-789-3766), so I use the website value and flag the discrepancy.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-250-789-3033 but the website lists 250-789-3766 as both the main line and the Hotel & Liquor Store line. Website value used; OSM tag should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel with on-site food, grocery, and laundry — a genuinely useful stop for a touring cyclist in northern BC.

Laundry.detail: Website /hotel page: 'We offer a laundry service available at our inn. Ask at the front desk for details.' Also confirmed on /contact-us: 'we offer reasonable rates by the day, week or month, as well as laundry service.'

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site pub serves evening meals (Wednesday–Sunday evenings per hours listed) and the restaurant also serves dinner hours Monday–Saturday

Nearby grocery.detail: On-site liquor store stocks 'a small selection of groceries, pops, drinks and more' per /liquor-store page

wow_evidence: food, drink, and laundry all under one roof
